name: Kingdom Death: Simulator
summary: Kingdom Death: Simulator (KDS) is a digital project in development that aims to recreate the tabletop game Kingdom Death: Monster (KDM) in an online, sandbox environment. It provides players with a virtual dwelling and game room where they can play the core KDM game, including various expansions, either solo or with friends. The simulator offers a way to experience KDM, explore its content, and potentially introduce new players to the game.
